notes.title: OFFICIAL MISSION STATEMENT
notes.content:
Hello, future operatives,

[previewyoutube=9nuLBiTmI2U;full][/previewyoutube]

Together with CRITICAL REFLEX, Subtle Bravado Studios now operates outside normal jurisdiction to contain anomalous objects, entities and phenomena. We exist to support normalcy by maintaining anomalies requiring Special Containment Procedures, commonly shortened to as "SCPs". Under our watch civilians can sleep without fear, live without doubt and exist without questioning customary beliefs.

Welcome to the Foundation, and good luck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c0072b3ae837eefb41825ba86398b7a5994e5c62.png

That which is hidden will be brought to light. Infiltrate the labs of nefarious Valravn research facilities as Leena Sorjova, an elite GOC combat operative. Amalgamate forces with Field Agent Walker and uncover hundreds of fateful secrets and classified documents. When war is declared, truth is the first casualty.

Eat or be eaten. Face off against an army of the specialized mercenaries and weaponized anomalies. Challenge mad gods and murderous AI. Outwit your foes or become the prey. Death is breathing down your back in the silence of narrow corridors of Valravn corporation.

Victory is earned, not given. Blur the line between action and stealth. Pay close attention to enemy callouts and plan your attacks before it’s too late. Keep the track of your munition against the foes that bend the borders of reality. Adapt and shape your destiny. Nothing is impossible here.

Hold your loved ones tight and join Critical Reflex Discord and Publisher Page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/9e1793f0fdae8b8749d6bbd7fdbc6d1ab2ee0cad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827864/2510a7aed052689adc5a03ed02bfb920df1f8f6d.png

This is far from being over.
